highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 development improves GPU rendering correctness and updates HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0.
highlights_body: The unreleased changes correct reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, improve affected Vulkan device-loss cleanup, and bound Graphite clip recording. HarfBuzzSharp also gains 30 named script constants.

bullets.lead: More reliable hairlines and GPU text
bullets.detail: Corrects oversized square caps on zero-length hairlines under reflected transforms, guards against non-finite cap calculations, and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture for ordinary and LCD text.

Adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42.0 up to, but not including, 56.0. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed; affected-device behavior was not specifically verified in the integration review.

Flushes based on effective undrawn clip elements to keep recording within render-pass limits. A draw whose clips cannot fit even in a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing the pass structures.
Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and aligns HarfBuzzSharp and its NativeAssets package versions at 15.0.0, while retaining the HarfBuzzSharp assembly version at 1.0.0.0.

Adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, for 179 named values matching the native script list. Existing fields, values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact.
